scope: one instrument shared by calibration (Stage C) and IOTA-MIN-L0 (Stage S); no per-model tuning

observables_per_run.n_t: number of active units at tick t (definition supplied by each model; for IOTA see iota_spreading.json)
observables_per_run.r2_sum_t: sum over active units at tick t of squared minimum-image Euclidean distance from the seed site
observables_per_run.absorbed_at: first tick at which the model's absorbing test holds, or null
observables_per_run.censored_at: first tick at which any active or ever-active unit lies at minimum-image Chebyshev distance >= L/2 - 4 from the seed, or null

aggregates.P_t: fraction of runs with absorbed_at null or > t
aggregates.N_t: mean of n_t over all runs, absorbed runs contributing zero
aggregates.R2_t: sum over surviving runs of r2_sum_t divided by sum over surviving runs of n_t

censoring.rule: each run contributes to aggregates only for ticks before its censored_at
censoring.fit_window_upper: t_max = largest tick such that the fraction of runs alive at t with censored_at <= t is at most 0.01; if t_max < 4*t_min the point is classified 'window_too_short'

local_slopes.method: Grassberger local effective exponents on a geometric tick ladder
local_slopes.ladder: t_k = round(t_min * 2^(k/4)) for k = 0,1,... while t_k <= t_max

criticality_test.precheck: if fewer than 1% of runs are absorbed by t_max, or fewer than 50 runs in absolute number, the point is classified 'no_absorption_observed' and treated as supercritical for bracketing; this prevents a flat P(t) = 1 (zero local slope) from being read as critical
criticality_test.statistic: weighted least-squares slope s of delta_eff versus ln t over admissible ladder points, weights from bootstrap variances

classes.subcritical: s > 0 and its 95% bootstrap interval excludes 0
classes.supercritical: s < 0 and its 95% bootstrap interval excludes 0

bracketing.coarse: evaluate every registered coarse-grid point; the bracket is the first adjacent pair (lower subcritical, upper supercritical) in increasing control order
bracketing.no_bracket: if no adjacent subcritical/supercritical pair exists, the model terminal status is 'no_bracket_in_registered_range' and no exponents are reported
bracketing.multiple_brackets: all adjacent subcritical-to-supercritical pairs are reported; the lowest is primary; more than one is itself a registered finding (re-entrant or multiple transitions)
bracketing.bisection: geometric midpoint for IOTA (control spans decades), arithmetic midpoint for calibration; a critical_compatible midpoint is retained and bisection continues toward the side whose endpoint has the larger |s|
bracketing.final_point: the evaluated point with the smallest |s| among critical_compatible points in the final bracket, else the final bracket midpoint; it is re-run with runs_at_final_point fresh seeds

exponent_estimate.value: mean of the local effective exponent over the upper half of admissible ladder points at the final point
exponent_estimate.statistical_se: bootstrap standard error of that mean
exponent_estimate.systematic_se: half the absolute difference between the same estimate at the two final bracket endpoints
exponent_estimate.drift_report: the full local-slope series is always reported; a monotone drift across the window is flagged 'crossover_in_window'

verdict.<class_id>: exactly one registered class matches and every other registered class is excluded

classification.separation_check: the 3D tolerances are below half the DP_3p1/DyP_3 separation in every exponent (delta 0.39, theta/eta 0.38, z 0.52), so a single estimate cannot match both

consistency_checks.use: reported alongside the verdict; a matched class whose own hyperscaling check fails is downgraded to 'indeterminate'

static_cluster_size.quantity: S, the number of sites ever activated (L0) or reached (CAL-SITE-BFS-SC-3) in a run, including the seed
static_cluster_size.ccdf: F(s) = fraction of runs with S >= s, using all runs; a censored run counts as S >= s for every s up to its S at censoring
static_cluster_size.exact_range: s from 16 to s_cut, where s_cut is the smallest S-at-censoring among censored runs (F is exact on this range despite censoring)
static_cluster_size.estimate: tau - 2 = minus the least-squares slope of ln F(s) against ln s on a geometric ladder of s values with ratio 2^(1/4) in the exact range
static_cluster_size.se: bootstrap over runs (1000 resamples) combined in quadrature with half the difference between the estimates at the two final bracket endpoints
static_cluster_size.minimum_range: if s_cut < 256, the static estimate is 'range_too_short' and H3 is indeterminate
